precepts.text: Behold the man whose name is The BRANCH; and he shall build the temple of the Lord: not the second temple; this is about the third and the fourth. He shall bear the glory, and shall sit and rule upon his throne; and he shall be a priest upon his throne: and the counsel of peace shall be between them both: going into the priesthood and the kingship, and Christ fulfilled both.
precepts.point: In that day shall ye call every man his neighbour under the vine and under the fig tree: that is in the kingdom.
precepts.why:
The Branch appears again in Zechariah 6: “Behold the man whose name is The BRANCH; and he shall grow up out of his place, and he shall build the temple of the Lord.” That is not the second temple; it is about the third and the fourth.

“Even he shall build the temple of the Lord; and he shall bear the glory, and shall sit and rule upon his throne; and he shall be a priest upon his throne: and the counsel of peace shall be between them both.” Both is the priesthood and the kingship. He sits and rules on his throne as a king, and he is a priest on that same throne.

That is why Zechariah 3 speaks to Joshua the high priest, and why Zerubbabel the governor stands alongside him: the priest from Levi and the ruler from Judah. Christ fulfilled both offices, the priesthood and the kingship, in one man, the Branch.

precepts.text: Behold the man whose name is The BRANCH, referring to Christ; He shall build the temple of the Lord, bear the glory, sit and rule upon His throne, and be a priest upon His throne.
precepts.point: The Lord hath sworn and will not repent, thou art a priest forever after the order of Melchizedek. Christ is the priest forever after this order.

note.label: Psalm 110: Sit Thou at My Right Hand

precepts.why:
“Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchizedek.” Zechariah shows the same man, a king who is also a priest: “Behold the man whose name is The BRANCH; and he shall grow up out of his place, and he shall build the temple of the Lord”.

The BRANCH is Christ. “Even he shall build the temple of the Lord; and he shall bear the glory, and shall sit and rule upon his throne; and he shall be a priest upon his throne: and the counsel of peace shall be between them both.” He sits and rules upon his throne and is a priest upon that throne at the same time. That is the priest forever after the order of Melchizedek, sworn by the Lord who will not repent.

This explains the two mountains. “These shall stand upon mount Gerizim to bless the people, when ye are come over Jordan; Simeon, and Levi, and Judah, and Issachar, and Joseph, and Benjamin: And these shall stand upon mount Ebal to curse; Reuben, Gad, and Asher, and Zebulun, Dan, and Naphtali.” When we went in the wilderness there were two huge mountains, and God split Israel up. He said these tribes go on this mountain to send forth the blessings, and the rest of you tribes go on the other mountain and you bring forth the curses that come if you break God's commandments.

The north country is Babylon the great, North America. “Ho, ho, come forth, and flee from the land of the north,” So the Lord is telling Israel to flee from the land of the north; this is North America. It is saying the same thing Revelation 18:4 says, come out from among her, my people, making reference to Babylon. Flee, meaning flee spiritually, mentally. “saith the Lord: for I have spread you abroad as the four winds of the heaven, saith the Lord.” Because he spread us worldwide; that is the four winds of the heaven.

“Deliver thyself, O Zion, that dwellest with the daughter of Babylon.” Now he says deliver thyself, O Zion. Somebody may say, wait a minute, the daughter of Babylon, isn't that the ancient Cushites? No, it is not; Psalms 137 shows it is Edom. The land of the north is what you want to highlight: land of the north, North America. And that Zion right there, listen good, is mainly Judah.

Who is the daughter of Babylon? “Remember, O Lord, the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem; who said, Rase it, rase it, even to the foundation thereof. O daughter of Babylon,” See what it is calling Edom: the daughter of Babylon. This is the so-called white man. “who art to be destroyed; happy shall he be, that rewardeth thee as thou hast served us.” So when we go back to Zechariah 2:7, deliver thyself, O Zion, that dwellest with the daughter of Babylon, that daughter of Babylon is Edom.

What does it mean that they quieted our spirit in the north country? It means they shut us up. “How art thou fallen from heaven, O Lucifer,” Lucifer is the so-called white man. You have been taught that Lucifer is some spiritual demon, but Lucifer here is talking about the so-called white man. People get stupid about fallen from heaven: see, he was up in the sky with God. Lamentations 2:1 says God cast down from heaven unto the earth the beauty of Israel; that doesn't mean we were flying in the sky. It means we were at one time the top nation on earth and we fell to hell, meaning captivity, a low estate. So it is the same context: Lucifer is going to fall from heaven. Remember Revelation 18, Babylon is fallen, is fallen; it is talking about the same thing.

“son of the morning!” Lucifer means light-bearer. You ever see the Statue of Liberty? She is holding up a torch, meaning she is a light-bearer for the world: you want knowledge, you want wisdom, you want anything, you come here. That is America's message. “how art thou cut down to the ground, which didst weaken the nations!”

“For thou hast said in thine heart,” This is what Lucifer, the so-called white man, Babylon, says. “I will ascend into heaven,” Meaning they will concoct and create a way to get up to space. “I will exalt my throne above the stars of God:” 1969, the first moon landing. People get stupid: oh, they never went to the moon, it's impossible, there is something around the earth's atmosphere that prevents you from passing it. My jailhouse Negroes: did the white man create airplanes? Yeah. So this other part in the Bible about space is fake? You stupid as hell; go sit your black behind down somewhere. Why is Trump creating a Space Force if you can't go up there? Stop listening to black people.

“I will sit also upon the mount of the congregation, in the sides of the north:” That is what we wanted right there. In the sides of the north, meaning North America. So what did he do when it says they sit upon us? He conquered us in North America. That goes with Zechariah 6:8, they have quieted my spirit in the land of the north: they conquered us.

The Israelites explain this fall from heaven. “How hath the Lord covered the daughter of Zion with a cloud in his anger, and cast down from heaven unto the earth the beauty of Israel,” So he cast the Israelites down from heaven. Does that mean we were flying in the sky? No, it does not. It means we were at one time the top nation on earth, and we fell to hell, meaning captivity, a low estate. So when Isaiah 14:12 says how art thou fallen from heaven, O Lucifer, it is in the same context: your friendly neighborhood white man is going to fall from heaven.

Write this down: the white horse goes back to Zechariah 6:3. “And in the third chariot white horses;” So this white horse goes back to the same white horse of Zechariah 6:3, wherein this man would go forth and conquer.

The red horse goes with Zechariah 6:2. “In the first chariot were red horses; and in the second chariot black horses;” So we are dealing with the red ones now. Remember what Revelation 6:4 said: the red horse takes away peace from the earth, that is very key, and there was given unto him a great sword. Genesis 25 shows why it says red.

We read this at the beginning of class. “In the first chariot were red horses; and in the second chariot black horses;” So these black horses, back in Revelation 6, deal with the dark nations, all they term as black people, primarily in Africa.
The pale horse precepts with Zechariah 6:3. “And in the third chariot white horses; and in the fourth chariot grisled and bay horses.” See that part, grisled: that goes into the pale horses.

note.label: Zechariah 6: The Four Chariots and the Crowning of Joshua

points: “And I turned, and lifted up mine eyes, and looked, and, behold, there came four chariots out from between two mountains; and the mountains were mountains of brass.” Zechariah sees a vision: he sees chariots. Chariots are what Esau calls UFOs; we call them IFOs, identifiable flying objects. They flew between two mountains. The two mountains are explained in Deuteronomy 27:12-13: when we were in the wilderness there were two huge mountains, and God split Israel up. These tribes go on this mountain to send forth the blessings, and the rest of you tribes go on the other mountain and bring forth the curses that come if you break God's commandments.

“In the first chariot were red horses;” The first chariot Zechariah sees is red. “and in the second chariot black horses;” The second, he sees black horses. “And in the third chariot white horses; and in the fourth chariot grisled and bay horses.” Write this word down: grisled. Grisled and bay goes into the pale horses.

“Then I answered and said unto the angel that talked with me, What are these, my lord? And the angel answered and said unto me, These are the four spirits of the heavens, which go forth from standing before the Lord of all the earth.” Write this down: the four spirits are the first four seals which are opened in Revelation 6.

“The black horses which are therein go forth into the north country; and the white go forth after them;” Write this down: the north country is making reference to Babylon the great, or North America. Zechariah 2:6-7 says ho, ho, come forth, and flee from the land of the north; the Lord is telling Israel to flee from North America, spiritually, mentally, the same thing Revelation 18:4 says, come out from among her, my people. Deliver thyself, O Zion, that dwellest with the daughter of Babylon: the daughter of Babylon is not the ancient Cushites, it is Edom, the so-called white man (Psalms 137:7-8). And that Zion is mainly Judah. “and the grisled go forth toward the south country.” That is going into South America.

“And the bay went forth, and sought to go that they might walk to and fro through the earth: and he said, Get you hence, walk to and fro through the earth. So they walked to and fro through the earth.”

“Then cried he upon me, and spake unto me, saying, Behold, these that go toward the north country have quieted my spirit in the north country.” That lets you know that Israel would be in the north country; the bulk of Israel would be in North America. What does it mean, he quieted our spirit on this side? It means they shut us up. Lucifer, the so-called white man, said in his heart I will sit also upon the mount of the congregation, in the sides of the north, meaning North America (Isaiah 14:12-13): when it says they sit upon us, he conquered us in North America. That goes with they have quieted my spirit in the land of the north: they conquered us.
